Skin type: Dry, sensitive Product: The Ordinary Glycolic Acid 7% Toning Solution I bought this after seeing it everywhere—recommended by dermatologists and skincare professionals—and at this price point, it felt worth trying. It absolutely lives up to the hype. I don't use this as a facial toner. Instead, it's become a multi‑use workhorse for the body: Applied with a cotton pad to feet, knees, and elbows to help smooth dry, rough skin Let it absorb fully, then follow with a moisturizer Works extremely well for this purpose I also use it on underarms and the bikini area after waxing to help prevent ingrown hairs. Important note: I only apply it after all redness and irritation are gone (usually around day 3 post‑wax). It's effective, easy to use, and incredibly affordable for how many uses you get out of it—clearly a product that can stretch far beyond one intended purpose. As you can probably tell from how low my bottle is, a refill is already on my list. I know there are countless other ways to use this product, and I feel like I'm just getting started.

avis.titre: HOLY GRAIL for body odor! Life changing
avis.texte: Haven't used on my face, but this is absolutely LIFE CHANGING for body odor. I've used natural deodorant without aluminum for the last couple of years, and no matter which one I try, by the end of the day, I still can smell some BO around my armpits. I've basically just been living with this and doing what I can, reapplying when possible, and always putting detergent on the armpits of my shirts before the wash. I finally said enough and did some googling and found that using glycolic acid on your armpits can massively reduce the smell. I've been doing it for at least a week now, spraying it on my armpits every other night at the end of the night after a shower when my armpits are fully clean. I do not apply deodorant after. When I wake up, I have no smell, which is not typical for me. I then shower in the morning and apply deodorant once and I'm good for the whole day. I keep sniffing my armpits because it's so hard for me to believe this is working so well lol. For the first time in a couple years, I feel like I don't have to worry about body odor at all. Haven't had any irritation or sensitivity, despite using every other night. If you deal with BO ar all, absolutely try this. I hope it keeps working like this forever.
